Standard: Interior lighting does not cause glare, reflection, or halation across the range of lighting settings. If reflections, glare, and halation exist on the canopy, windshields, and windows they will be minimized. Reflections, glare, and halation that affect the outside vision of the crewmembers will not impact the ability to fly the air vehicle. Reflections, glare, and halation resulting from lighting sources do not obscure the displayed flight-critical information when viewed from the crewmembers’ design eye point. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
(1) Show that interior lighting does not cause glare, reflections, or halation which could interfere with their interior or exterior vision and impact the ability to fly the air vehicle. Demonstration will take place under no moon or equivalent environment.
